definition.def: To facilitate an action or process, especially one that you would like to happen, means to make it easier or more likely to happen.
examples: The new airport will facilitate the development of tourism. [VERB noun]
He argued that the economic recovery had been facilitated by his tough stance. [be VERB-ed]
